items.item_text: Must have Radiology License and Registered through ARRT.
BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Must have previous experience in specialty area, preferably at least one year.

Join UC San Diego Health for an in-person Radiology Hiring Event on Thursday, November 19, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM! Meet our hiring leaders, learn about current Radiology healthcare openings, and discover exciting Healthcare Technology career opportunities all in one place.

Working in Radiology at UC San Diego Health means joining a nationally recognized, academic medical leader where excellence, innovation, and patient-centered care are more than just words, they’re lived every day. UC San Diego Health consistently ranks among the top health systems for quality and safety, reflecting a culture that values advanced technology, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

In Radiology, you’ll work with state-of-the-art imaging equipment and multidisciplinary teams that support fast, accurate diagnostics and impactful outcomes. The organization prioritizes professional growth and development, offering ongoing education, training, and opportunities to advance your skills and career. Beyond the clinical and technical advantages, you’ll be part of a community dedicated to excellence, inclusion, and meaningful work that truly makes a difference in patients’ lives.
Please be sure to upload your most recent resume with all relevant radiology education and experience. While not required, a cover letter is highly recommended when applying.
Recent graduate of a school of radiologic technology.
Must be able to function in a high-paced environment and have excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Strong critical thinking, de-escalation, and problem-solving skills to manage multiple levels of information and responsibilities.
